title: Car A speed
description: Essential: Student correctly extracts Car A's constant speed from its displacement-time graph.

title: Car B acceleration
description: Essential: Student correctly extracts Car B's constant acceleration from its velocity-time graph.

title: Catch-up time
description: Essential: Student correctly solves for the time when Car B's displacement equals Car A's displacement.

title: Equal speeds condition
description: Important: Student identifies that maximum separation occurs when the two cars have equal instantaneous speeds.

title: Maximum separation calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the displacement difference at the time of equal speeds.

title: Kinematic equations
description: Important: Student correctly applies displacement formulas for constant velocity (Car A) and constant acceleration (Car B).

title: Sign error in difference
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly subtracts displacements (e.g., Car B - Car A) when finding maximum distance.

title: Graph misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Student misreads the graphs, leading to incorrect initial speed/acceleration values.

title: Units in final answer
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (s and m) with final numerical answers.
